Interior improvements include new cabinets and counter tops, Energy Star appliances, tubs/showers, new flooring, base, and paint throughout. cold shell for the commercial spaces. All new insulation on entire exterior envelope as part of the work. We are looking at 36 family sized units over retail/restaurant space.
